$comment: The app permission vocabulary: every name a manifest may request or a permission gate accepts, the words the install screen, the permission prompt and Settings show, and the lint policy. sensitive: the manifest must give a reason in permissionReasons. restricted: only Marathon's own apps may request it, and only its protected system apps hold it; any other app is refused it. aliases: older names that mean a permission listed here; manifests must use the permission's own name.
